sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 5 月 26 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：MU、UBS、MSFT、NVDA、RKLB。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

关键事件（搜索已确认）：

  • MU UBS PT raised from $535 to $1,625: UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri issued the highest target on Wall Street, based on a 2029E EPS of $117 × 15x P/E. He projects EPS to remain above $100 long-term, with a five-year cumulative FCF exceeding $400B. The core narrative is that LTAs (three-to-five-year long-term agreements with MSFT Azure / Google Cloud / AWS) are transforming DRAM from a cyclical stock into a structural asset. MU jumped 12% at the open to $843, becoming the sole "center of the universe" today.
  • Nasdaq breaks 30,000 for the first time in history: Widely marked by the community as a milestone; "NASDAQ 30k LFG" is flooding the feed.
  • Iran situation escalates again but is completely ignored by the market: U.S. forces conducted "self-defense strikes" last night against missile launch sites and Iranian mine-laying boats near Bandar Abbas. Iran accused this of being a "gross violation" and threatened retaliation, while the IRGC claimed to have shot down a U.S. drone. Oil dropped 4% in early trading before flipping green to $93. Explosions in Hormozgan province + an oil tanker explosion 60 miles off the Oman coast + warnings of a "decisive swift response" from the Iranian Foreign Minister and the Aerospace Chief of the Revolutionary Guard were all digested by algorithms as noise.
  • Israel expands ground operations beyond the yellow line in Lebanon: A standalone headline that failed to move the market.
  • 5/27 Tuesday pre-market Consumer Confidence expected to beat estimates: However, the monthly Michigan survey remains at its lowest level since 1947 (44.8). The narrative is strong, but no one in the market is trading it.

社区情绪：极度乐观+自我监管密度不断上升。 SPY 突破 750 美元/751 美元后，社区开始说“任何低于一美分的涨幅都是下跌日”，“任何低于 +2% 的涨幅都是红色日”。与此同时，内部多头情绪反复警告顶部：“这种自我破坏/地毯拉扯的臭味将是极其令人讨厌的。”恐惧与贪婪指数估计在 78-85 范围内。熊实际上已经灭绝了——“Bers 说 MU 会回到 500”和“BERS 今天之后就会灭绝”是获得最多支持的评论。 “炸弹=泵/没有炸弹=泵”已经铭刻在集体意识中。

对比：消费者信心处于 1947 年以来的最低点，纳斯达克指数为 30k，SPY ATH 为 751 美元。结构性分歧仍在继续，但 WSB 已完全放弃将其用于交易决策。
